assessment: The near-term rate ceiling and two-year yield peak were wrong, as was the no-reform outlook for drug pricing. The Merge timing and immediate ETH decline worked, though market co-movement limits causal attribution. The first three-year bullish equity and Bitcoin directions were positive, while five-year defensive income claims remain open. Bank balance-sheet analysis needs funding and duration stress, and Fedi development claims require clear release milestones and conflict disclosure.

Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
